structured_output.summary: The change follows the spec steps in order. RequireObjectCoercible and ToString both propagate errors with `?`. Full lowercase mappings come from kahvi_unicode. Final_Sigma is implemented per the Unicode condition: a cased letter before, skipping case-ignorables, and no cased letter after, skipping case-ignorables. Lone surrogates map to themselves. If the Cased or Case_Ignorable tables are missing, it throws not_implemented rather than guessing. The `.skip(i + 1)` lint flag is just the lookahead after the sigma. The one remaining test failure comes from RegExp.prototype.toString being unimplemented, which is unrelated to this ticket.
